integrity.proof_basis: elementary matrix commutators, exact unit minor over \(\mathbb F_3\), central descent, exact block algebra
integrity.publication_priority: qualified; independent historical priority not established

scientific_limitations: Only Lie algebras \(\mathfrak{sl}_3(k)\) and \(\mathfrak{psl}_3(k)\), for fields \(k\) of characteristic exactly three.
The rank certificate is an exact 48-by-48 minor; it is not a universal method for other Lie types.
An earlier implicit statement in unlocated small-characteristic literature is not excluded.
title: Characteristic-three Hom–Lie rigidity and central extensions of type A2
